note: CROSS-REPO migration shipped as TWO impl jobs in sequence. Job 1 (plugin v2.5.0) MUST ship before Job 2 (codexu adoption). See plan.md 'Sequencing' for the why. The bookkeeper lead should spawn impl members job-by-job, not story-by-story across both jobs at once.

jobs.name: job-1-plugin-migration
jobs.shipTarget: main + marketplace registration; bump to v2.5.0
jobs.executionRationale: Cross-story shared-file risk on scripts/lib/parse-overview-data.mjs (US-A1) and scripts/lib/default-config.mjs (US-A2) with downstream readers in US-A3, US-A6. Serial keeps merges trivial; parallel saves wall-clock but burns review attention.

clusters.name: foundation
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-A1 and US-A2 are file-disjoint. Safe to run in parallel inside one impl member, but recommend serial for low cognitive load — both are foundation primitives needed by US-A3 and US-A4. Serial lands cleanly in 2 commits.

clusters.name: watcher

sharedFiles: tools/overview-mcp/src/__tests__/three-mcp-integration.test.ts (also touched by viewer if viewer needs MCP integration test updates — unlikely; should be exclusive to this cluster)

clusters.executionModeRationale: Depends on US-A2 (new default lockFile path). File-disjoint from viewer (US-A4); can run in parallel with viewer cluster inside phase 2 if running parallel impl members; otherwise serial in single member.

clusters.name: viewer
clusters.executionModeRationale: Depends on US-A2 (new outputs paths). Independent of US-A3 (watcher cluster). Parallel-safe with watcher inside phase 2. Largest single story by surface area.

clusters.name: skills
clusters.executionModeRationale: Depends on US-A2 (skills reference new defaults). Independent of US-A3 and US-A4 file surfaces. Parallel-safe with tests-and-docs cluster inside phase 3.

clusters.name: tests-and-docs
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-A6 (cross-cutting tests) depends on all earlier stories being implemented. US-A7 (CHANGELOG + docs + version bump) must land LAST in the job — it's the release-readiness gate. US-A6 can run in parallel with US-A5 if the impl member is comfortable resolving any test-file additions; otherwise serial.

jobs.name: job-2-codexu-adoption
jobs.executionRationale: Strictly mechanical work plus verification. Stories build on each other (B2 needs B1's converted files; B3 needs B2's deletes; B4 needs all three). Parallelism would only add coordination overhead with zero throughput gain.
jobs.precondition: Job 1 (plugin v2.5.0) must be SHIPPED and the local plugin install must reflect v2.5.0 (verify with `node bin/ralph-overview.mjs --version` or equivalent).

clusters.name: migrate-data
clusters.executionModeRationale: Strictly serial. US-B1 creates the new layout; US-B2 verifies via sync and then deletes the old files. Cannot be parallelized — atomicity matters.

clusters.name: docs
clusters.executionModeRationale: Mechanical find-and-replace. Depends on US-B2 so the docs match reality.

clusters.name: smoke
clusters.executionModeRationale: Verification only — no code commit expected unless smoke gates surface a small follow-up. Final gate before ship.

followUps.summary: Add overview.snapshot, overview.task, overview.sidecar_diagnostics MCP tools so skills can flip to MCP-only (currently hybrid MCP-first + config-aware fallback per OQ #3 of the migration plan).
Retire codexu's gitignored bin/ralph-overview.mjs resolver wrapper in favor of direct $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT / $COPILOT_HOME paths in package.json scripts (OQ #6 of the migration plan).
followUps.blockedBy: none (independent of migration; can land separately)
